data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 181.515m. Using the published gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2018-2021) show a net increase in gross estimates of approximately GBP 4.675m (2.6% of opening reserves) representing an overall strengthening of prior year reserves. The report also highlights net prior-year adverse development of GBP 9.5m on a net (after reinsurance) basis and cites catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Ian in 2022 and other weather events) and reinsurance/cession movements as contributors. A prior-year commutation of cessions attaching to 2018-2020 was disclosed and may affect comparability. Per-line prior-year movements are available in the note but are reported net of reinsurance there.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 9.5m (2022: GBP 12.3m).
net CAT losses of GBP 10.8m (2022: GBP 26.4m) were recorded.
The main 2023 events were Turkish Earthquakes, Hurricane Idalia, Fort Lauderdale flooding, UK winter storms and Storm Ciaran.

In the prior year the net CAT losses were significantly higher due to the more severe impact of Hurricane Ian which made up 68% of the total CAT losses, plus the impact of French hailstorms and the Ukraine conflict.

During the prior year the cession business attaching to the 2018 to 2020 underwriting years of account was commuted effective 30 November 2022. The liability of the Syndicate for future claims therefore ceased.

data.data_quality_notes: Total gross prior year development was calculated from the Gross Claims Development table (triangle) on page 30. The report also states a net (after reinsurance) adverse prior year movement of GBP 9.5m; the per-line prior year breakdown printed in the same note is presented net of reinsurance, so line-by-line amounts above are taken from the net breakdown and have lower confidence. A commutation of cessions attaching to 2018-2020 (noted in the report) may affect comparability of older years and distort reinsurance-related movements. Where gross per-line movements were not published, net figures from the prior-year analysis were used (flagged in confidence).
